patches.value: H^u(B)=μH[u](B) denotes Mathlib's unnormalized Hausdorff measure, the metric measure mkMetric for the gauge r↦r^u on the Borel sigma algebra. The metric-measure construction takes countable-cover outer contents for this gauge, with the empty-set gauge cost forced to zero, and their supremum as the scale tends to zero. Its precise cover evaluation will be applied as an explicit native source, rather than assumed as an extra premise. No spherical or dimensional normalization factor is used.

For B in an extended metric space, equipped with its Borel measurable structure when computing H, dimH(B)=sup{d∈[0,∞): H^d(B)=∞}, the supremum taken in [0,∞] and with sup ∅=0. This is native Mathlib dimH. Positive-exponent critical-exponent directions are invoked as explicit native sources. We use no zero-exponent measure assertion.
